in_marathi.name: Yuvraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prince, Young King
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yuva means young and raja means king. This name is derived from Sanskrit language and is used to describe a young and powerful king in Hindu mythology. The name evokes feelings of royalty, power, and youth.
